**Description**
 Amazon CloudFront is Amazon's global content delivery network, delivering content from 400\+ edge locations across 90\+ cities in 48 countries. CloudFront accelerates static and dynamic web content, video streaming, APIs, and software distribution for customers ranging from startups to the world's largest media companies. It handles live events at scale (Thursday Night Football, FIFA World Cup, Prime Video) where milliseconds of latency and seconds of availability directly impact customer experience.

**Plot, Explained**
**Plot turns social videos into answers.**
 People don’t just talk about brands anymore, they
 *show* 
 them. In videos. In routines. In offhand moments – even when they’re not explicitly tagged.
   

  

 Most of what matters now lives in social video, but it’s buried in volume. Plot exists to surface what actually matters.
   

  

 We analyze millions of social videos to help teams answer questions like:
   

  

* Why do people love (or avoid) this product?
* What patterns are forming across how people use it, talk about it, and feel about it?
* Who are the fans consistently showing up without being asked?


 Plot watches the feed for you pulling signal from speech, visuals, on\-screen text, and comments and turning it into insight you can explore, ask questions about, and act on.
   

  

 It’s part social listening, part research tool, part creative workspace rebuilt for a video\-first world.
   

  

 In less than a year since launch, Plot is already trusted by leading enterprise brands including Lululemon, Benefit Cosmetics, Anthropologie, CAVA, Visa, and more. We’re now entering our next phase of growth raising the bar on quality, cohesion, and craft as enterprise adoption accelerates.
   

  

 Plot is venture\-backed by Seven Seven Six (Alexis Ohanian), XYZ Ventures, and Mischief Ventures.
   

  

**Small Team. High Bar.**
 We keep the team lean and we favor builders over process.
   

  

 Plot is made up of people who are intrinsically motivated to do great work – the kind of people who don’t need heavy structure to know what needs to happen next. Our team brings experience from places like Uber, Dropbox, Microsoft, and Apple, alongside deep startup experience building 0→1 products.
   

  

 We move fast, but we care deeply about quality. We ship, learn, iterate and then we make it feel right.
   

  

**Why Plot, you ask?**
 Design is core to how Plot works.
   

  

 We started scrappy. Early prototypes were built in days, shipped in weeks, and helped us land our first enterprise customers. That speed got us here. Now we’re entering a new phase — one where we get to take what we’ve built and make it
 *exceptional* 
 .
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work on a product with real traction and real complexity, and to help define how it evolves. You’ll have meaningful ownership, a strong voice in product decisions, and the space to think holistically while sweating the details.
   

  

 As a designer at Plot, you’ll get to:
   

  

* Help raise the bar on quality while keeping the momentum that made Plot successful
* Shape a product that adapts to different roles, use cases, and ways of working
* Design AI\-first workflows that feel obvious, useful, and trustworthy


**Where you’ll spend your time**
 You’ll help shape the product as well as the design culture at Plot, including:
   

  

* Designing core product experiences from early concepts to shipped features
* Defining and evolving Plot’s design patterns, systems, and practices
* Raising the bar for visual craft, interaction quality, and polish
* Partnering closely with engineers to ship thoughtful, high\-quality work
* Talking directly to customers – joining calls, observing workflows, and translating needs into product decisions
* Prototyping quickly to explore ideas, test assumptions, and make things real
* Occasionally helping tell the story through decks, docs, or visuals


**The Kind Of Designer We’re Excited About**
 This role is for a designer who is:
   

  

**A tinkerer at heart** 
 . You build things. You prototype ideas instead of just talking about them. You have side projects, experiments, half\-finished tools and you learn by doing.
   

  

**Fluent with AI tools and workflows.** 
 You actively use AI tools in your day\-to\-day work and you’re excited to design AI\-first experiences that feel human and intentional.
   

  

**Strong in craft and taste.** 
 We’re building for creatives. Visual quality, interaction design, and polish matter deeply. You have a point of view and the judgment to know when to push and when to simplify.
   

  

**A systems thinker.** 
 You think in patterns, not one\-off screens. You care about cohesion, consistency, and how things scale over time.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity and speed.** 
 You don’t need perfect requirements to start. You can navigate unclear problems, make decisions with incomplete information, and iterate as you learn.
   

  

**Product\-minded.** 
 You care about outcomes, not just outputs. You think about user goals, business context, and long\-term impact.
   

  

**What We Value**
 Curiosity.
   

  

 Taste.
   

  

 Speed with intention.
   

  

 Humility.
   

  

 Playfulness.
   

  

 We care far more about how you think and build than where you’ve worked or how many years you’ve been doing it.

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**
 Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.
   

  

 Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Conflict Simulation Laboratory (CSL) of the Global Security Computing Applications Division (GS\-CAD) within the Computation Directorate has an opening for a
 **Software Developer** 
 specializing in the analysis, design, development, and implementation of C\+\+ scientific software. The CSL develops and deploys the Joint Conflict and Tactical Simulation (JCATS) and JCATS Low Overhead Driver (JLOD) simulation suites to users around the world. The CSL works closely with external partners to enable JCATS and JLOD to interoperate with other simulation models and tools in a federated environment.
   

  

 JCATS and JLOD are tactical simulations that model soldiers, tanks, and other military platforms maneuvering in 3D environments. Line of sight, projectile paths, collision detection, and many other algorithms calculate real time results for military trainers and analysts. You will analyze, design, and implement new functionality using object\-oriented, C\+\+ programming and object\-oriented algorithms, while balancing performance tradeoffs. CSL simulation products are used for training and analysis by 30 countries, the Departments of Energy and War, and other government agencies. Their applications include military operations, peacekeeping, drug interdiction, homeland defense, site security, and civil defense preparation.
